name: Gyakuten Prince
source:
The protagonist, who moved overseas as a child, is now a sophomore in high school and
returns to Japan to transfer to the prestigious Seioji Academy.

There, she reunites with her childhood friend, a boy who has been chosen as the “Grand Prince”—the school’s prince-like figure—and, through a series of unexpected events, she also becomes friends with the other three prince candidates…!?

[MTL translation from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/15233]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
幼年移居海外的女主角如今升入高中二年级，回到日本转入了名门学府——圣王子学园。

在那里，她与儿时的青梅竹马重逢——那个少年如今已被推选为学园里王子般的存在“首席王子”；而在一连串意想不到的机缘巧合下，她也与其他三位王子候选人熟络了起来……！？

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/15233]NovelGame[/url]]
